definitions.explanation: The resistance encountered when surfaces move against each other (physics).
Disagreement or tension between people, groups, or nations (figurative).

examples.japanese: {摩擦|まさつ}で{熱|ねつ}が{発生|はっせい}する。
{両国|りょうこく}の{間|あいだ}に{貿易|ぼうえき}{摩擦|まさつ}が{生|しょう}じた。
examples.english: Trade friction arose between the two countries.

examples.japanese: {人間関係|にんげんかんけい}の{摩擦|まさつ}を{避|さ}けたい。
examples.english: I want to avoid friction in interpersonal relationships.

notes:
{摩擦|まさつ} is used both literally (physical friction) and figuratively (conflict between people/groups).

Physics context:
- {摩擦|まさつ}{力|りょく} (frictional force)
- {摩擦|まさつ}{係数|けいすう} (coefficient of friction)
- {摩擦|まさつ}{熱|ねつ} (frictional heat)

Social/political context:
- {貿易|ぼうえき}{摩擦|まさつ} (trade friction)
- {国際|こくさい}{摩擦|まさつ} (international friction)
- {人間関係|にんげんかんけい}の{摩擦|まさつ} (interpersonal conflict)

Related terms:
- {衝突|しょうとつ} (collision, clash - more intense)
